# rasuvaeff/resilience

Resilience pipeline for PHP: composes rasuvaeff/retry,
rasuvaeff/circuit-breaker, and rasuvaeff/bulkhead in the correct order with
the exception glue built in. Namespace `Rasuvaeff\Resilience`. The PHP
analogue of Polly's ResiliencePipeline / resilience4j's Decorators.

## Install

```bash
composer require rasuvaeff/resilience
```

## Rules

- PHP 8.3+, `declare(strict_types=1)`, immutable `final readonly` classes.
- Default nesting: `retry(circuitBreaker(bulkhead(callback)))`. Bulkhead is
  INNERMOST — a slot is occupied only while the callback runs, re-requested
  per attempt, free during retry sleeps. The breaker wraps the bulkhead, so
  an open circuit rejects before a slot is requested.
- `build()` appends glue `stopIf` predicates to a COPY of the retry builder
  (`Retry` is immutable — the passed instance is never modified, user
  predicates are preserved): stop on `CircuitOpenException` (always), on the
  breaker's `StorageFailure` (always), and on `BulkheadFullException`
  (default; opt back into retrying with `->retryOnBulkheadFull()`).
- `->breakerOutsideRetry()`: the whole retry loop becomes ONE breaker
  outcome (a transient blip fixed by a retry never reaches the failure
  ratio; the trade-off is that an open circuit cannot cut the loop short).
  Default (`BreakerInsideRetry`): every attempt is one outcome and an open
  circuit stops the remaining attempts instantly.
- Every layer is optional; an empty pipeline is a plain call.
- Terminal exceptions surface UNCHANGED (`RetryExhausted`,
  `CircuitOpenException`, `BulkheadFullException`, `StorageFailure`, or the
  callback's own); the optional `fallback` receives whichever ended the
  call, at the outermost level.
- The breaker's `isFailure` classifier sees `BulkheadFullException` (the
  breaker wraps the bulkhead) — classify it as not-a-failure unless local
  saturation should deliberately open the circuit.
- `->onRejected(fn (\Throwable $r): \Throwable => new MyUnavailable(previous: $r))`:
  maps ONLY rejections (`CircuitOpenException`, `BulkheadFullException`,
  pre-call `StorageFailure`) at the outermost level, before `fallback` (which then
  receives the mapped exception). Other exceptions pass through untouched.
- `Rejection::is($e)`: true for the three rejections. `StorageFailure` only
  with `operation` `admit`/`snapshot`; `recordOutcome` = the callback already
  ran, NOT a rejection. False for
  `RetryExhausted` (even when its last attempt was rejected) and anything
  else. `Rejection::retryAfter($e, ?ClockInterface $clock = null): ?Duration`:
  time until half-open for `CircuitOpenException`, the slot lease (upper
  bound) for `BulkheadFullException`, `null` otherwise.
- `bulkhead()` takes any `Rasuvaeff\Bulkhead\Bulkhead`; `circuitBreaker()` any
  `Rasuvaeff\CircuitBreaker\CircuitBreakerInterface` (stubs/decorators OK).
- `call()` is generic (`@template T`): returns the callback's type.
- The pipeline itself does no I/O and defines no exception types.

## API reference

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Resilience\Pipeline;
use Rasuvaeff\Retry\Retry;

$pipeline = Pipeline::for('stripe')          // non-empty name, for diagnostics
    ->bulkhead($sharedBulkhead)              // Rasuvaeff\Bulkhead\Bulkhead (SharedBulkhead, decorator, stub)
    ->retry(Retry::new()->maxAttempts(maxAttempts: 4)->withExponential(baseMs: 100, multiplier: 2.0, capMs: 5_000))
    ->circuitBreaker($circuitBreaker)        // Rasuvaeff\CircuitBreaker\CircuitBreakerInterface
    ->breakerOutsideRetry()                  // optional order switch
    ->retryOnBulkheadFull()                  // optional glue opt-in
    ->onRejected(fn (\Throwable $r): \Throwable => new StripeUnavailable(previous: $r))
    ->build();                               // CompiledPipeline (immutable, reusable)

$result = $pipeline->call(fn(): mixed => doWork());
$result = $pipeline->call(
    callback: fn(): mixed => doWork(),
    fallback: fn(\Throwable $e): mixed => degrade($e),
);
$pipeline->name(); // 'stripe'

use Rasuvaeff\Resilience\Rejection;
Rejection::is($e);                       // bool
Rejection::retryAfter($e, $clock);       // ?Rasuvaeff\Duration\Duration
```

`PipelineOrder` enum: `BreakerInsideRetry` (default) | `BreakerOutsideRetry`.
